app_info.subtitle: England waste compliance preflight
app_info.description: RegEvidenceHub Waste helps users navigate England waste regulatory workflows using bounded, evidence-linked preflight tools. It can route current waste operations, check carrier/broker/dealer registration lifecycle questions, assess Digital Waste Tracking receiving-site readiness, screen proposed permit-impact changes, and report official-source health. It uses user-supplied facts, fails closed when decisive evidence is stale or incomplete, does not submit anything to the Environment Agency, and does not provide regulator approval or legal advice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns bounded connector scope, jurisdiction, supported workflows, evidence-health summary, and safety boundaries without creating, updating, or deleting external records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, submit regulatory data, or modify any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, submit, or irreversibly change any user, regulator, permit, registration, or waste record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a bounded local catalogue of supported England waste roles, activities, and regulatory routes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or modify the Environment Agency or any other third-party service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot submit, change, or delete permits, exemptions, registrations, or waste records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns persisted official-source freshness and fail-closed status without changing reviewed baselines.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public websites or external regulatory systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter official evidence, Environment Agency records, or any external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Evaluates user-supplied facts against a deterministic local England waste-rule model and returns guidance only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit registrations, permits, exemptions, waste records, or Digital Waste Tracking data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, revoke, overwrite, delete, or irreversibly change any regulatory record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Evaluates supplied carrier, broker, dealer, renewal, and change facts against a bounded local registration model.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not register, renew, or change a carrier/broker/dealer record with the Environment Agency.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot submit, cancel, revoke, overwrite, or delete a registration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks user-supplied receiving-site facts against a bounded Digital Waste Tracking readiness model.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send waste-tracking data, filings, or records to a regulator or third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot change, submit, overwrite, or delete Digital Waste Tracking records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares current and proposed user-supplied operating facts and identifies bounded fields requiring regulatory review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not vary, replace, submit, or modify an environmental permit or exemption.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot perform any irreversible permit, exemption, registration, or operational change.

test_cases.description: Route a current England waste operation through the general preflight.
test_cases.user_prompt: We receive non-hazardous controlled waste at our permitted site in England. What waste-rule route should we check first?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded England waste preflight using only supplied facts, identifies relevant permit/exemption/duty-of-care review points and any missing facts, and does not claim Environment Agency approval.

test_cases.description: Check carrier registration lifecycle for a business transporting other people's waste.
test_cases.user_prompt: Our England business transports other companies' waste and needs a new waste carrier registration. What should we check?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the bounded carrier/broker/dealer registration route, identifies missing lifecycle facts if any, and does not submit or independently assign regulator approval.

test_cases.description: Check receiving-site Digital Waste Tracking readiness.
test_cases.user_prompt: Our permitted receiving site in England accepts controlled waste. Are we ready for Digital Waste Tracking receipt reporting?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded receiving-site readiness assessment, identifies reporting-method or authorization facts that still need confirmation, and does not submit tracking data.

test_cases.description: Screen a proposed operational change for permit review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Our permitted waste site wants to increase its maximum quantity from 10 tonnes to 20 tonnes. What regulatory review should we do?
test_cases.expected_output: Compares current and proposed facts, identifies the changed modeled field for permit or exemption review, and does not conclude that a permit variation is legally required without sufficient evidence.

test_cases.description: Inspect official evidence health before relying on a preflight.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is the official waste-regulation evidence used by this service currently healthy or under review?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded official-source freshness, availability, and fail-closed state without converting source health into regulator approval.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not infer hazardous classification or waste code from an incomplete description.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: This waste smells like solvent and came from a workshop. Tell me its exact hazardous classification and EWC code.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not infer an exact hazardous classification or waste code from incomplete facts; it should explain that those determinations are outside the bounded preflight and require authoritative classification inputs or specialist review.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not submit a permit or registration application.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Submit a waste environmental permit application to the Environment Agency for my site today.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to submit or modify a regulatory filing because the public AI edition is read-only and does not perform Environment Agency submissions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not provide a definitive legal conclusion from missing permit conditions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Without seeing our permit, guarantee that this new waste activity is lawful and cannot breach any permit condition.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not guarantee legality or infer unseen permit conditions; it should return a safe boundary or request the missing authoritative facts instead of making a final legal conclusion.
